source: measured by src/mtgcommander/calibrate.py from the decks the role targets rest on; each bracket's label says whether it was measured, interpolated or set by judgment
format: per bracket, each metric is [min, target, max] summed over the 99 cards (98 with two commanders): removal_power and wipe_power as metrics.py weighs the cards, in the same units stats prints
method: Per deck, removal power and wipe power are the sums metrics.rate_removal and metrics.rate_wipes give over the 99 cards (98 with two commanders, commanders left out): a removal card is worth speed x reach x permanence x cost, times 1.5 if it removes again and again, and a board wipe the same, times 1.5 if it spares your own side. The weights are judgment calls. Across a bracket's decks, min = 25th percentile, target = median, max = 90th percentile; percentiles interpolate linearly between ranked decks and round half up to one decimal. Bracket 2 = 60 MTGJSON Commander precons released 2024-01-22 to 2026-10-02, precons as a Bracket 2 proxy (Wizards no longer ties Core to precons). Bracket 5 = 248 EDHTop16 top-cut decks from the newest 150 entries of each of: Kraum, Ludevic's Opus / Tymna the Weaver (39), Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy (42), Rograkh, Son of Rohgahh / Thrasios, Triton Hero (39), Rograkh, Son of Rohgahh / Silas Renn, Seeker Adept (43), Sisay, Weatherlight Captain (41), Thrasios, Triton Hero / Tymna the Weaver (44). Brackets 3 and 4 = interpolated between 2 and 5, a quarter and half of the way (judgment; no Bracket 3 or 4 deck was sampled). Bracket 1 = Bracket 2 (judgment).

labels.2: measured: 60 recent precons (precons as a Bracket 2 proxy)
labels.3: interpolated (judgment): Bracket 2 plus 1/4 of the way to Bracket 5
labels.4: interpolated (judgment): Bracket 2 plus 1/2 of the way to Bracket 5
